# Forma (full documentation for language models)

# Forma for AI agents

Generated by `forma-xaml docs`; the same text ships in the `forma-ui` skill (`forma-xaml agent install`).

# Authoring Forma views

A view is one root element with `data-class` (the code-behind type) and `data-type` (the view-model type), preceded by
`<meta name="f-namespace" content="local=clr-namespace:My.ViewModels">` lines and an optional `<link rel="stylesheet" href="theme.fcss">`.

```html
<meta name="f-namespace" content="local=clr-namespace:Game.ViewModels">
<div data-class="Game.Views.PauseView" data-type="local:PauseViewModel">
  <div id="MenuPanel" class="surface border" style="border-width: 1px; padding: 16px 18px; border-radius: 3px; min-width: 360px">
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px">
      <span class="title" bind:text="TitleText" style="align-self: center"></span>
      <button id="ResumeButton" class="button" bind:text="ResumeText" onclick="OnResumePressed"></button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Tokens and classes

`:root { --color-surface: #070D18DA; --space-4: 5px; }` in `.fcss` declares tokens; the property name is the resource key.
Use them with `var(--color-surface)`. Colors are `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`. Theme overrides: `:root[data-theme="dark"] { … }`.

## Controls

Application controls are registered with `<meta name="f-element" content="my-spin=views:SpinBox">` or placed with
`<f-control type="views:SpinBox" id="…">`. Set any Forma property directly with `f:Property="value"`.

## Templates, lists, grids, tabs

- Control template: `<template for="button" id="MyButton"><f-border part="chrome"><slot></slot></f-border></template>`, applied with
  `-f-Template: template(MyButton)` in a rule.
- List: `<ul bind:items="Rows" selectable><template data-type="local:RowVm" src="Row.fhtml"></template></ul>`.
- Grid: `<table bind:items="Rows"><thead><tr><th width="2*"></th></tr></thead><tbody><template data-type="local:RowVm"><tr><td>…</td></tr></template></tbody></table>`.
- Tabs: `<div role="tablist"><div role="tabpanel" id="General">…</div></div>`.

## Animation

`@keyframes fade { from { opacity: 0.88; } to { opacity: 1; } }` and `#Root { animation: fade 140ms ease-out forwards; }`. An
animation targets one `#id`. Start it from code with the storyboard named after the animation.

# Tools

| Task | Command or MCP tool |
| --- | --- |
| Check a view or stylesheet | `forma-xaml validate [--format human|json|sarif] <file|dir>` |
| Format | `forma-xaml format [--check] <file|dir>` |
| Render one view | `forma-xaml preview View.fhtml -o out.png [--state hover] [--lang ja] [--scale 130] [--size 1280x720]` |
| Reference docs | `forma-xaml docs --out docs` (regenerates); `forma-xaml docs --out docs --check` (drift) |
| Find controls in the live app | game MCP `game_ui` `ui-query button=<css selector>` |
| Why is a rule (not) applied | game MCP `game_ui` `ui-inspect button=<id, name or selector>` |
| Element or region screenshot | game MCP `take_screenshot selector=<css>` or `clip=x,y,w,h` |
| Preferences and devices | game MCP `game_ui` `ui-emulate key=reduced-motion|dark|keyboard|gamepad|…` |
| Install or check this skill | `forma-xaml agent install|update|doctor` |

Preview renders with the application, so give it a long timeout (3 minutes) and read the PNG afterwards. A view with no scene
in the project's preview host cannot be previewed; preview the nearest screen and say so.

The `forma-xaml mcp` server exposes `validate`, `format`, `preview` and the generated docs to any MCP client.

# Troubleshooting

- **A diagnostic** (`FHTMLnnnn`): read its `Help:` line; it names the supported alternative. `references/support-matrix.md` lists
  every property, selector and at-rule with its status.
- **My style is not applied**: `ui-inspect button=<selector>` lists every rule with MATCH or NO and the reason, and the winning
  value with `file:line`. Typical causes: a type selector for the wrong control, a missing class, specificity, a rule in a
  view that does not link the stylesheet.
- **A value looks wrong**: colors are `#RRGGBBAA` in `.fcss` (alpha last), not `#AARRGGBB`.
- **Padding changed the layout**: on a flex or grid element it wraps the container in a Border; use `margin` for outside space.
- **A class style on a ColorRect moved text**: set the color as an element value instead.

# HTML and CSS dialect support matrix

Generated by `forma-xaml docs`; do not edit. Status: supported, or rejected with the nearest supported alternative.

## Elements and constructs

| Construct | Lowers to |
| --- | --- |
| div (plain) | `Container` |
| div (display: flex, row) | `HBoxContainer` |
| div (display: flex, column) | `VBoxContainer` |
| div (padding, border, background) | `Border` |
| div (display: grid) | `GridPanel` |
| section, nav, main, header, footer | `Container` |
| span, p, label, h1-h6 | `Label` |
| button | `Button` |
| input type=text | `LineEdit` |
| input type=checkbox | `CheckBox` |
| input type=range | `HSlider` |
| textarea | `TextEdit` |
| select | `OptionButton` |
| ul, ol, li | `VBoxContainer` |
| table | `GridPanel` |
| f-border | `Border` |
| f-scroll | `ScrollContainer` |
| f-group-box | `GroupBox` |
| f-control | `Control` |
| <style> tokens (:root, var()) | `Container` |
| <style> @media and transition | `Container` |
| ::part() and part attribute | `Container` |
| typed and attribute selectors | `Control` |
| <template for> control template with <slot> and part | `Container` |
| ul/ol bind:items with <template> | `Container` |
| ul selectable bind:items | `Container` |
| table bind:items data grid | `Container` |
| ARIA tablist and tabpanel | `TabContainer` |
| dialog | `Container` |
| @keyframes and animation | `Container` |
| @media prefers-reduced-motion and prefers-color-scheme | `Container` |
| progress | `Container` |
| details and summary | `Container` |
| hr and empty div as ColorRect | `Container` |
| registered custom element | `Container` |
| box model: padding on flex wraps in a Border; margin | `Border` |
| flex-wrap and overflow | `HFlowContainer` |
| align-items and justify-content | `HBoxContainer` |
| width, height and max sizes | `Container` |
| data-* state and [data-*] selectors | `Container` |
| :is(), :first-child, :nth-child(), [disabled] | `Container` |
| :focus-visible | `Container` |
| theme overrides :root[data-theme] | `Container` |
| dir and lang | `Container` |
| data-i18n | `Container` |
| box-shadow, gradient, transform, radius | `Container` |
| text effects | `Container` |
| -f-Property and resource() | `Container` |

## CSS properties

| Property | Status | Example or alternative |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | supported | `display: flex` — flex, grid, block or none |
| `flex-direction` | supported | `display: flex; flex-direction: column` — row or column |
| `flex-wrap` | supported | `display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap` — nowrap or wrap (flow container) |
| `gap` | supported | `display: flex; gap: 8px` — flex containers and grids |
| `justify-content` | supported | `display: flex; justify-content: center` — start, center, end |
| `align-items` | supported | `display: flex; align-items: center` — start, center, end, stretch |
| `align-self` | supported | `align-self: center` — start, center, end, stretch |
| `flex-grow` | supported | `flex-grow: 1` — needs a flex parent |
| `flex` | supported | `flex: 1` — 1, auto, 0, none |
| `vertical-align` | supported | `vertical-align: middle` — top, middle, bottom |
| `text-align` | supported | `text-align: center` — left, center, right |
| `width` | supported | `width: 120px` — fixed size (minimum and maximum) |
| `height` | supported | `height: 40px` — fixed size (minimum and maximum) |
| `min-width` | supported | `min-width: 120px` — px or rem |
| `min-height` | supported | `min-height: 40px` — px or rem |
| `max-width` | supported | `max-width: 300px` — px or rem |
| `max-height` | supported | `max-height: 300px` — px or rem |
| `margin` | supported | `margin: 4px 8px` — one to four lengths; margin-top/right/bottom/left too |
| `padding` | supported | `padding: 4px 8px` — on a flex or grid element it wraps the container in a Border |
| `border-width` | supported | `border-width: 1px` — one to four lengths |
| `border-color` | supported | `border-color: #33CDFF` — #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA |
| `border-radius` | supported | `border-radius: 3px` — one to four radii |
| `background-color` | supported | `background-color: #112233` — #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA |
| `background` | supported | `background: linear-gradient(180deg, #000000, #FFFFFF)` — linear-gradient and radial-gradient |
| `color` | supported | `color: #E0F8FF` — text color |
| `font-size` | supported | `font-size: 24px` — px or rem |
| `font-weight` | supported | `font-weight: bold` — normal, bold, 400, 700 |
| `font-style` | supported | `font-style: italic` — normal, italic, oblique |
| `opacity` | supported | `opacity: 0.5` — 0 to 1 |
| `overflow` | supported | `overflow: hidden` — hidden clips; wrap in f-scroll to scroll |
| `box-shadow` | supported | `box-shadow: 0 2px 4px #80000000` — x y [blur [spread]] color [inset] |
| `text-shadow` | supported | `text-shadow: 1px 1px #000000` — x y color (blur is not drawn) |
| `text-transform` | supported | `text-transform: uppercase` — uppercase or none |
| `text-overflow` | supported | `text-overflow: ellipsis` — ellipsis or clip |
| `white-space` | supported | `white-space: nowrap` — nowrap or normal |
| `transform` | supported | `transform: scale(1.1)` — translate(), scale(), rotate() |
| `transform-origin` | supported | `transform-origin: 50% 50%` — keywords and percentages |
| `pointer-events` | supported | `pointer-events: none` — none or auto |
| `transition` | supported | `transition: opacity 150ms` — property and duration |
| `box-sizing` | supported | `box-sizing: border-box` — border-box only |
| `grid-template-columns` | supported | `display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr` — px and fr tracks |
| `position` | rejected | `position: absolute` — no overlay mapping; use <dialog> or an OverlayPanel |
| `float` | rejected | `float: left` — use display: flex |
| `filter` | rejected | `filter: blur(2px)` — the renderer has no filters; use opacity |
| `backdrop-filter` | rejected | `backdrop-filter: blur(2px)` — the renderer has no filters |
| `outline` | rejected | `outline: 1px solid #000000` — use border-width and border-color |
| `mix-blend-mode` | rejected | `mix-blend-mode: multiply` — no blending; use opacity |
| `clip-path` | rejected | `clip-path: circle(50%)` — use overflow: hidden |
| `line-height` | rejected | `line-height: 1.4` — size the box with min-height |
| `letter-spacing` | rejected | `letter-spacing: 1px` — the text engine has no tracking control |
| `text-decoration` | rejected | `text-decoration: underline` — the text engine has no decoration |
| `cursor` | rejected | `cursor: pointer` — cursors are set by the control |
| `font-family` | rejected | `font-family: Arial` — faces come from the theme |
| `flex-shrink` | rejected | `flex-shrink: 1` — boxes never shrink below their minimum size |
| `flex-basis` | rejected | `flex-basis: 10px` — set min-width or min-height |
| `order` | rejected | `order: 1` — reorder the markup |
| `margin-inline-start` | rejected | `margin-inline-start: 4px` — use margin-left or margin-right |

## Selectors

- Type, class, id, descendant and child (`>`) combinators, `:is()`, `:where()`, `:not()`; sibling combinators are rejected.
- Pseudo-classes: `:hover`, `:focus`, `:focus-visible`, `:focus-within`, `:active`, `:disabled`, `:checked`, `:selected`, `:first-child`, `:last-child`, `:only-child`, `:empty`, `:nth-child(an+b)`, `:host`.
- Attributes: `[data-*]`, `[disabled]`, `[checked]`, `[type=checkbox|range|text]`, `[role=tablist]`.
- Template parts: `::part(name)`. `ul.x li` and `table.x tr` select realized items. Other pseudo-elements are rejected.

## At-rules

- `@media (input-modality: …)`, `(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`, `(prefers-color-scheme: light|dark)`, `(min-width|max-width: Npx)`; `@keyframes`.
- `@import`, `@font-face`, `@supports`, `@container` and `!important` are rejected.

## Units

`px`, `rem`, plain numbers, `fr` in grid tracks, `ms` and `s` in animations. Percentages, `em`, `vw` and `vh` are rejected.

## Diagnostics

Every error has a stable code, a source location and a help line.

- `FHTML1001` syntax error
- `FHTML1002` unknown element
- `FHTML1003` unknown attribute
- `FHTML1004` rejected construct
- `FHTML1005` structure error
- `FHTML1006` link target problem
- `FHTML2001` unknown CSS property
- `FHTML2002` unsupported unit
- `FHTML2003` invalid value
- `FHTML2004` unsupported selector
- `FHTML2005` rejected property

# HTML and CSS dialect reference

Generated by `forma-xaml docs` from the catalog the converter tests compile; do not edit.

## div (plain)

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<div><span>x</span></div>
```

## div (display: flex, row)

Lowers to `HBoxContainer`.

```html
<div style="display: flex; gap: 4px"><span>a</span><span>b</span></div>
```

## div (display: flex, column)

Lowers to `VBoxContainer`.

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px"><span>a</span></div>
```

## div (padding, border, background)

Lowers to `Border`.

```html
<div style="padding: 4px; border-width: 1px; background-color: #112233"><span>a</span></div>
```

## div (display: grid)

Lowers to `GridPanel`.

```html
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr"><span>a</span><span>b</span></div>
```

## section, nav, main, header, footer

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<section><span>a</span></section>
```

## span, p, label, h1-h6

Lowers to `Label`.

```html
<p>Text</p>
```

## button

Lowers to `Button`.

```html
<button>Go</button>
```

## input type=text

Lowers to `LineEdit`.

```html
<input type="text" value="a">
```

## input type=checkbox

Lowers to `CheckBox`.

```html
<input type="checkbox" checked>
```

## input type=range

Lowers to `HSlider`.

```html
<input type="range" min="0" max="10" value="2">
```

## textarea

Lowers to `TextEdit`.

```html
<textarea></textarea>
```

## select

Lowers to `OptionButton`.

```html
<select></select>
```

## ul, ol, li

Lowers to `VBoxContainer`.

```html
<ul><li><span>a</span></li></ul>
```

## table

Lowers to `GridPanel`.

```html
<table><tr><td>a</td><td>b</td></tr></table>
```

## f-border

Lowers to `Border`.

```html
<f-border><span>a</span></f-border>
```

## f-scroll

Lowers to `ScrollContainer`.

```html
<f-scroll data-vertical="Auto"><span>a</span></f-scroll>
```

## f-group-box

Lowers to `GroupBox`.

```html
<f-group-box><span>a</span></f-group-box>
```

## f-control

Lowers to `Control`.

```html
<f-control type="Control"></f-control>
```

## <style> tokens (:root, var())

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<style>:root { --accent: #FF8800; --dim: 0.5; } span.a { color: var(--accent); opacity: var(--dim); }</style><div><span class="a">x</span></div>
```

## <style> @media and transition

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<style>@media (input-modality: pointer) { button.b:hover { opacity: 0.5; } } button.b { transition: opacity 150ms; }</style><div><button class="b">x</button></div>
```

## ::part() and part attribute

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<style>button.k::part(chrome) { opacity: 0.5; }</style><div><span part="chrome">x</span></div>
```

## typed and attribute selectors

Lowers to `Control`.

```html
<style>input[type=checkbox] { opacity: 1; } table.t { opacity: 1; } [role=tablist] { opacity: 1; } select { opacity: 1; }</style><div></div>
```

## <template for> control template with <slot> and part

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<style>button.t { -f-Template: template(tb); }</style><template for="button" id="tb"><f-border part="chrome"><slot></slot></f-border></template><div><button class="t">x</button></div>
```

## ul/ol bind:items with <template>

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<meta name="f-namespace" content="t=clr-namespace:Forma.Xaml.Compiler.Tests;assembly=Forma.Xaml.Compiler.Tests"><div data-type="t:ListModel"><ul bind:items="Rows"><template data-type="t:RowModel"><div><span bind:text="Name"></span></div></template></ul></div>
```

## ul selectable bind:items

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<meta name="f-namespace" content="t=clr-namespace:Forma.Xaml.Compiler.Tests;assembly=Forma.Xaml.Compiler.Tests"><div data-type="t:ListModel"><ul selectable bind:items="Rows"><template data-type="t:RowModel"><div><span bind:text="Name"></span></div></template></ul></div>
```

## table bind:items data grid

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<meta name="f-namespace" content="t=clr-namespace:Forma.Xaml.Compiler.Tests;assembly=Forma.Xaml.Compiler.Tests"><div data-type="t:ListModel"><table bind:items="Rows"><thead><tr><th>Name</th></tr></thead><tbody><template data-type="t:RowModel"><tr><td><span bind:text="Name"></span></td></tr></template></tbody></table></div>
```

## ARIA tablist and tabpanel

Lowers to `TabContainer`.

```html
<div role="tablist"><div role="tabpanel" id="One"><span>1</span></div></div>
```

## dialog

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<dialog backdrop="scrim"><span>x</span></dialog>
```

## @keyframes and animation

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<style>@keyframes f { from { opacity: 0.5; } to { opacity: 1; } } #a { animation: f 200ms ease-out; }</style><div><span id="a">x</span></div>
```

## @media prefers-reduced-motion and prefers-color-scheme

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<style>@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { span.m { opacity: 0.5; } } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { span.m { font-weight: bold; } }</style><div><span class="m">x</span></div>
```

## progress

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<div><progress value="1" max="2"></progress></div>
```

## details and summary

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<div><details><summary>t</summary><span>x</span></details></div>
```

## hr and empty div as ColorRect

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<div><hr style="background-color: #112233"></div>
```

## registered custom element

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<meta name="f-element" content="my-label=Label"><div><my-label></my-label></div>
```

## box model: padding on flex wraps in a Border; margin

Lowers to `Border`.

```html
<div style="display: flex; padding: 4px; margin: 2px"><span>x</span></div>
```

## flex-wrap and overflow

Lowers to `HFlowContainer`.

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; overflow: hidden"><span>x</span></div>
```

## align-items and justify-content

Lowers to `HBoxContainer`.

```html
<div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end"><span>x</span></div>
```

## width, height and max sizes

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<div style="width: 10px; height: 20px; max-width: 30px"><span>x</span></div>
```

## data-* state and [data-*] selectors

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<style>span[data-state=open] { opacity: 0.5; }</style><div><span data-state="open">x</span></div>
```

## :is(), :first-child, :nth-child(), [disabled]

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<style>span:is(.a, .b):first-child { opacity: 1; } span:nth-child(2n+1) { opacity: 1; } button[disabled] { opacity: 1; }</style><div><span class="a">x</span></div>
```

## :focus-visible

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<style>button.k:focus-visible { opacity: 0.5; }</style><div><button class="k">a</button></div>
```

## theme overrides :root[data-theme]

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<style>:root { --a: #112233; } :root[data-theme="dark"] { --a: #000000; } f-border.c { background-color: var(--a); }</style><div><f-border class="c"><span>x</span></f-border></div>
```

## dir and lang

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<div dir="rtl" lang="ar"><span>x</span></div>
```

## data-i18n

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<div><span data-i18n="menu.play"></span></div>
```

## box-shadow, gradient, transform, radius

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<div><f-border style="box-shadow: 0 2px 4px #80000000; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #000000, #FFFFFF); border-radius: 3px; transform: scale(1.1)"><span>x</span></f-border></div>
```

## text effects

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<div><span style="text-shadow: 1px 1px #000000; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; font-style: italic">x</span></div>
```

## -f-Property and resource()

Lowers to `Container`.

```html
<style>span.c { -f-Opacity: 0.5; color: resource(External.Color); }</style><div><span class="c">x</span></div>
```

## CSS properties

- `display`: `display: flex` (flex, grid, block or none)
- `flex-direction`: `display: flex; flex-direction: column` (row or column)
- `flex-wrap`: `display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap` (nowrap or wrap (flow container))
- `gap`: `display: flex; gap: 8px` (flex containers and grids)
- `justify-content`: `display: flex; justify-content: center` (start, center, end)
- `align-items`: `display: flex; align-items: center` (start, center, end, stretch)
- `align-self`: `align-self: center` (start, center, end, stretch)
- `flex-grow`: `flex-grow: 1` (needs a flex parent)
- `flex`: `flex: 1` (1, auto, 0, none)
- `vertical-align`: `vertical-align: middle` (top, middle, bottom)
- `text-align`: `text-align: center` (left, center, right)
- `width`: `width: 120px` (fixed size (minimum and maximum))
- `height`: `height: 40px` (fixed size (minimum and maximum))
- `min-width`: `min-width: 120px` (px or rem)
- `min-height`: `min-height: 40px` (px or rem)
- `max-width`: `max-width: 300px` (px or rem)
- `max-height`: `max-height: 300px` (px or rem)
- `margin`: `margin: 4px 8px` (one to four lengths; margin-top/right/bottom/left too)
- `padding`: `padding: 4px 8px` (on a flex or grid element it wraps the container in a Border)
- `border-width`: `border-width: 1px` (one to four lengths)
- `border-color`: `border-color: #33CDFF` (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA)
- `border-radius`: `border-radius: 3px` (one to four radii)
- `background-color`: `background-color: #112233` (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA)
- `background`: `background: linear-gradient(180deg, #000000, #FFFFFF)` (linear-gradient and radial-gradient)
- `color`: `color: #E0F8FF` (text color)
- `font-size`: `font-size: 24px` (px or rem)
- `font-weight`: `font-weight: bold` (normal, bold, 400, 700)
- `font-style`: `font-style: italic` (normal, italic, oblique)
- `opacity`: `opacity: 0.5` (0 to 1)
- `overflow`: `overflow: hidden` (hidden clips; wrap in f-scroll to scroll)
- `box-shadow`: `box-shadow: 0 2px 4px #80000000` (x y [blur [spread]] color [inset])
- `text-shadow`: `text-shadow: 1px 1px #000000` (x y color (blur is not drawn))
- `text-transform`: `text-transform: uppercase` (uppercase or none)
- `text-overflow`: `text-overflow: ellipsis` (ellipsis or clip)
- `white-space`: `white-space: nowrap` (nowrap or normal)
- `transform`: `transform: scale(1.1)` (translate(), scale(), rotate())
- `transform-origin`: `transform-origin: 50% 50%` (keywords and percentages)
- `pointer-events`: `pointer-events: none` (none or auto)
- `transition`: `transition: opacity 150ms` (property and duration)
- `box-sizing`: `box-sizing: border-box` (border-box only)
- `grid-template-columns`: `display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr` (px and fr tracks)

# HTML and CSS cookbook

Generated by `forma-xaml docs`; each recipe is converted by a test on every build.

## Menu

A titled panel of full-width buttons.

```html
<div class="panel" style="border-width: 1px; padding: 16px 18px; border-radius: 3px; min-width: 320px"><div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px"><span style="align-self: center">Menu</span><button style="min-height: 46px">Play</button><button style="min-height: 46px">Quit</button></div></div>
```

## Settings row

A label, a flexible gap and a control on one row.

```html
<div style="display: flex; gap: 8px; min-height: 50px"><span style="min-width: 190px; align-self: center">Volume</span><div style="flex-grow: 1; pointer-events: none"></div><input type="range" min="0" max="100" style="min-width: 300px"></div>
```

## Form

Labelled text fields with a submit button.

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px"><span>Name</span><input type="text" style="min-width: 280px"><span>Server</span><input type="text" style="min-width: 280px"><input type="checkbox" checked><button>Save</button></div>
```

## Scrolling page

A fixed-size scroll area with a column of rows.

```html
<f-scroll data-vertical="Auto" style="min-width: 400px; min-height: 200px"><div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin: 6px"><span>One</span><span>Two</span><span>Three</span></div></f-scroll>
```

## Tabs

ARIA tabs: each tabpanel becomes a tab titled by its id.

```html
<div role="tablist" style="min-width: 300px; min-height: 200px"><div role="tabpanel" id="General"><span>General</span></div><div role="tabpanel" id="Sound"><span>Sound</span></div></div>
```

## Card with effects

A bordered surface with a gradient, shadow and rounded corners.

```html
<f-border style="border-width: 1px; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px #80000000; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #112233, #223344)"><span>Card</span></f-border>
```

## Dialog buttons

Centered action buttons under a message.

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px"><span style="align-self: center">Discard changes?</span><div style="display: flex; gap: 8px; align-self: center"><button style="min-width: 150px">Discard</button><button style="min-width: 150px">Keep</button></div></div>
```
